name: Lahore EV Owners Club
description: The largest EV community in Punjab. Monthly meetups, group charging trips and a very active parts-and-service recommendation thread.

name: Islamabad EV Community
description: Capital-region owners covering Islamabad and Rawalpindi. Organises northern-areas convoys through the summer.

name: Karachi Electric Riders
description: Karachi-wide group with a strong imported-EV contingent. Good place to ask about CHAdeMO and grey-import servicing.

name: Rawalpindi EV Circle
description: Smaller, practical group focused on home charging installs and shared workshop recommendations around the Pindi area.

name: Faisalabad EV Group
description: Growing fast since the first public charger opened. Mostly first-time EV owners helping each other through the early months.

name: Peshawar EV Drivers
description: KP-based owners coordinating on the limited charging available and running an informal roadside-help roster.

name: Multan EV Connect
description: South Punjab group covering Multan and Bahawalpur. Focused on making the long runs north genuinely practical.

name: Quetta EV Network
description: The newest club on Plug.pk. Small but determined, and the best source of information on charging in Balochistan.
